researchSummaryBody: For an optional research conversation, download counts and activity by relative week. This summary excludes your name, grades, course titles, answers, identifiers and exact activity dates. Nothing is uploaded. It measures recorded actions, not app visits or academic improvement.
demoSummaryExcluded: Demo data and simulated time are excluded from research summaries. Use your own study history for a pilot.
editedRulesNote: You have edited these rules. The source describes the original handbook values, not your changes.
institutionIntro: Choose a dated handbook snapshot, then check its programme and edition. Source comparison is automated; independent human review and current-cohort confirmation are still pending.
packApplicationNote: Applying changes the grading bands and degree-class thresholds. It keeps your courses, grades and retake setting. These packs do not establish how your retakes count; confirm that setting with your department. Course templates remain generic examples.
packGradeError: These rules do not recognise an existing grade. Check your courses before applying.
rulesApplied: Grading rules applied on this device.
notFound: Make we find your next small step.
memoryMode: You dey learn without saving. Changes stay only for this visit; refresh go clear am.
enableSaving: I agree — save my learning data for this device
progressSaved: Your step is saved on this device.
offlineUnavailable: Offline saving unavailable. Try a production build.
storageError: Your browser could not open local storage. Enable site storage, then reload.
saveError: Could not save changes. Your last saved data is safe. Export or retry before closing.
welcomeTitle: Your future start with one small step.
welcomeBody: Quiet space to learn, plan, and start again. For your first year and wetin come after.
nicknameHint: Nickname do. Other details no compulsory.
translation: Pidgin na machine translation; Pidgin speaker never review am. Some lesson content still dey English.
consentBody: Kora save your nickname, practice grades, progress, and settings for this device. No account, no tracker. You fit export or delete everything anytime. Source links open another website only when you choose am.
consentCheck: I understand and agree make Kora save my learning data for this device.
demoNote: A fictional Computer Science fresher with a 3.5 target. Replaces this device’s current mock learning data.
demoConfirm: Replace my data with the demo
homeIntro: You no need know everything now. Just choose your next small step.
todayBody: One task. Small time for your day. Start with plan wey you fit keep.
weekBody: Week wey you learn or use rest token count. No guilt for missed days.
restBody: Rest when you need am. Rest token keep this learning week.
restUsed: We don note your rest. This week count.
restEmpty: Your next learning week will bring two more tokens.
labTeaserBody: Try grade. See possibility. Plan your next semester.
neutral: Choose one small thing you can do today. You can begin again as often as you need.
recoveryBody: You wan try five-minute step today?
returnTitle: Welcome back. Make we continue easy.
recap: Revisit a lesson you already completed
gapReason: Some days don pass since your last learning session.
shortReason: Your last three sessions were shorter than your usual sessions.
skippedReason: You skipped a quiz in your last two sessions.
plannedReason: You have completed less than the study time you planned.
examReason: Your saved exam date is coming up.
disableOffers: You can turn suggestions off in Settings.
labTitle: Future wey you fit work towards.
labIntro: Try practice grades and see how small changes add up.
estimate: Estimate only. Your institution's rules decide your official result.
typical: Typical courses, editable. These are not an official school or CCMAS list.
noGrades: Add a mock grade to see your estimate.
retakeNote: Retakes replace the earlier graded attempt by default. Match the course code; change this assumption in Settings.
targetTitle: Where would you like to go?
targetBody: Use this mock plan as your completed baseline. Explore the next set of credit units.
reachable: This target fits within the selected scale.
unreachable: This target needs more points than the scale allows. A smaller step is available.
step: Aim for this step first, then reassess
noRemaining: No remaining units: the target depends on your baseline.
hoursNote: An editable planning heuristic, not a requirement. Adjust hours per unit in Settings.
scaleNote: Edit points and class thresholds to match your institution. Historical Pass classification may not apply; F=0 below 40 is a prototype assumption.
scaleInvalid: Keep grades within 0–5 and class thresholds strictly increasing within 0–5.
learnIntro: Five minutes, one useful idea. Every lesson dey open.
ttsUnavailable: Offline speech is unavailable on this device.
ttsNote: Uses a local device voice only. Voice availability depends on your device.
quizIntro: Take your time. You can try again, pause, or leave whenever you need.
incorrect: Here’s another way to look at it.
lessonSaved: Lesson completed. Your progress is saved here.
libraryIntro: Small stories and practical ideas, with sources you can check.
reportSaved: Error report saved on this device. Export it from Your data.
emptyLibrary: No verified entries match yet. Try another filter.
settingsIntro: Choose what works for you. You can change it anytime.
quietHint: Keep suggestions and motivation cards quiet.
adaptiveHint: Optional suggestions explain their reason. They never change access.
examHint: A generic semester is 12 teaching weeks, 2 revision weeks, and 2 exam weeks. Your institution decides actual dates.
demoOnly: The demo clock changes only this device’s planning time.
privacyIntro: No account. No tracker. Your learning data no go server.
storedBody: Your nickname, preferences, mock courses and targets, lesson and quiz progress, sessions, rest tokens, saved entries, and local error reports are stored in IndexedDB.
externalNote: Source links need internet and follow the linked site’s privacy policy. Text to speech uses local voices; Kora does not load online speech voices.
exportBody: Download a JSON copy, including locally saved error reports.
deleteBody: This clears all learning data and preferences on this device. Download an export first if you want a copy.
deleteConfirm: Your local learning data will be removed. This cannot be undone.
constraintsBody: Core runs on device. No AI helper or backend. No media downloads or external fonts. Pidgin and content need independent human review. Offline availability requires the production build’s service worker.
installHint: You can also use your browser’s “Add to Home Screen” option.
footer: Made for your next small step. Nigeria · Offline first
semesterTitle: A target. A plan. Your next step.
semesterIntro: Record results, keep deadlines together, and build a week you can adjust. Everything stays on this device.
actualNote: Enter only grades you have received. Planning grades in the Lab stay separate.
semesterEmpty: Add your courses in the Future Self Lab to start planning your semester.
targetToPlan: From your target to a plan
actualBaseline: This calculation uses recorded results only. Enter all credits still remaining towards your target, including later semesters.
targetStep: This target needs an average above the scale maximum. Explore a smaller target in the Lab and reassess as results arrive.
priorityReason: Courses with unfinished deadlines in the next seven days (including overdue work) come first, then higher credit units. These are editable priorities, not grade predictions.
weeklyBudget: Available study minutes over the next seven days
allocationNote: Suggestions share your available time across up to seven sessions, capped at 120 minutes each. Adjust dates and add breaks to suit you. Study time does not guarantee a grade.
noDeadlines: No deadlines yet. Add an assignment or exam when you know the date.
noSessions: No sessions yet. Try a suggestion or add your own.
calendarNote: Downloads your unfinished deadlines and sessions as all-day calendar events. Import the file into your calendar; changes in Kora do not update imported events.
practiceIntro: Recall an answer, check the explanation, then revisit it later. Practice is untimed and works offline.
reviewTomorrow: Missed answers return after one day. Correct answers get a longer review interval as you practise, up to 60 days.
practiceComplete: Practice complete. Your review schedule has been updated on this device.
restoreBody: Choose a Kora JSON backup (up to 10 MB). The file is checked on this device before you decide whether to replace your data. Older Kora backups are supported.
restoreError: This backup could not be restored. Check that it is a supported Kora export with valid data and under 10 MB. Your current data has not been replaced.
restoreReplace: Restoring replaces your current learning data. Export a backup first if you want to keep it. Your current storage consent stays unchanged; guest restores stay in memory.
confirmRestore: Replace my data with this backup
nextUsefulStep: Make room for your next study step.
suggestedReady: Review the dates and courses before adding these sessions.
offlineContents: Includes all lessons, questions, planning tools and the library. External source websites need internet.
offlineCheck: Offline download is not available yet. Wait for the ready indicator after installing a production build.
